motivation: Trial 2U provided positive multi-year historical evidence that BTC funding carry can survive conservative friction, while its frozen capitalization failed discontinuous mark-gap stress. Trial 11 tests the same broad economic mechanism on a distinct US-regulated perpetual venue with public first-party funding/bid/ask history, 0.0001 BTC contract granularity, and deliberately safer collateralization. This is a new trial, not a retune or rescue of Trial 2/8/9/10.

historicalDevelopmentWindow.selectionRule: Use the entire exact common public-data interval known from timestamp-only pre-freeze coverage. Do not select a favorable subwindow after observing values.
historicalDevelopmentWindow.role: historical development screen only; cannot promote or validate the strategy regardless of result

candidate.position: long Coinbase Exchange BTC-USD spot and short equal BTC units of Kalshi KXBTCPERP
candidate.entryRule: enter both legs once at the first frozen funding boundary using the exact Coinbase 1h candle open and Kalshi historical bid close at that boundary
candidate.exitRule: exit both legs once at the final frozen funding boundary using the exact Coinbase 1h candle open and Kalshi historical ask close at that boundary
candidate.sizingRule: determine BTC quantity from 15% of starting equity divided by the adverse-cost-adjusted Coinbase entry price, round DOWN to a whole 0.0001 BTC Kalshi contract, then buy and short exactly that BTC quantity
candidate.fundingAccounting: for every later frozen funding boundary, positive funding pays the short and negative funding is paid by the short; payment equals equal BTC units times public Kalshi mark_price times public funding_rate
candidate.basisAccounting: mark Coinbase spot independently using exact hourly opens and Kalshi short independently using the public funding-row mark price through time; entry/exit execution uses the frozen execution references and all frozen costs

kalshi.funding: public /funding_rates/historical?ticker=KXBTCPERP; require exactly one row at every frozen 8h boundary and fields market_ticker,funding_time,funding_rate,mark_price
kalshi.execution: public 60-minute KXBTCPERP candlesticks; require exact boundary candle and positive bid.close and ask.close
kalshi.identity: active market must contain exactly ticker KXBTCPERP and contract_size exactly 0.0001

coinbase.priceRule: require exact candle start at every frozen 8h boundary and use open price; no nearest candle or interpolation

rejectEvaluationIf: the funding series does not contain exactly 234 distinct frozen boundaries from start through end on an exact 8-hour grid
any funding_rate or mark_price is missing, non-finite, or invalid
any exact Kalshi boundary bid/ask candle is missing or non-positive
any exact Coinbase boundary spot open is missing or non-positive
any later observation is substituted for a frozen boundary
the compact synchronized input cannot be SHA-256 hashed

primary.kalshiExecutionReference: historical bid close to enter short; historical ask close to exit short, so displayed spread is already paid
primary.rationale: The 20 bps Kalshi reserve is intentionally above both the June FCM-applied exchange schedule and the newly certified self-clearing base tiers because a current public Kinetics retail all-in commission schedule was not verified before freeze. It is a conservative research proxy, not a claim about actual customer fees.

costModel.feeVerificationFirewall: No later Trial 11 result may be described as executable retail net performance or promotion-eligible unless the applicable Kinetics/FCM all-in fee schedule is independently verified. Historical development classification is unchanged regardless.

riskModel.futuresEquity: 30% starting-equity collateral reserve plus cumulative short mark-to-market P&L plus cumulative funding minus Kalshi entry fee
riskModel.historicalMarginFailure: fail at first boundary where futures equity is below 15% of current perp mark notional
riskModel.shockRule: at every historical boundary, apply each positive shock to the Kalshi mark while holding the Coinbase spot hedge outside the futures collateral account; report worst futures margin excess. This tests venue-local liquidation vulnerability, not total portfolio solvency.

primaryQuestions: Was net total-account P&L positive under frozen primary costs?
Was total funding income positive and larger than total friction plus residual hedge/basis loss?
Did the realized historical futures collateral path avoid the research maintenance threshold?
Did the 25% instantaneous mark shock avoid a margin breach?
Was the high-cost stress net P&L positive?

antiRescueRule: After the first Trial 11 economic output, do not change the window, funding interpretation, 15% spot target, 30% collateral reserve, 0.0001 BTC rounding, fees, slippage, execution references, maintenance threshold, shocks, or pass criteria under Trial 11. Any changed strategy/economic assumption requires a new trial number.
